lists.name: RYM Top — Scenes & Movements — Sunset Strip Glam Metal

podcast.body: This album, released in 1983, was the first by a heavy metal band to reach number one on the charts, marking a significant milestone for the genre. The band's popularity was immensely boosted by its accompanying video, which featured lead singer Kevin Dubrow in a face mask and red straightjacket, escaping a padded cell to join the band on stage. The crowd depicted in the video consisted of students from the California Institute of the Arts. The video for "Metal Health" cost $10,000 to make. "Metal health the album went to number one which was the first time a heavy metal band ever had a number one album."
